name: AMN Healthcare Services, Inc.
summary: AMN Healthcare Services, Inc. provides technology-enabled healthcare workforce solutions and staffing services to acute and sub-acute care hospitals, and other healthcare facilities in the United States. It operates through three segments: Nurse and Allied Solutions, Physician and Leadership Solutions, and Technology and Workforce Solutions.
